d: Mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ko lekar taiyariyan antim charan men hain aur mehmanon ke aagman ke lie helipaid bankar taiyar ho gaya hai. anant sinh ne svayan mauke par pahunchkar helipaid aur any vyavasthaon ki monitring ki. iske sath hi vahan aur helipaid banane ki bhi taiyari ki ja rahi hai.
